latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Editor for Mac — edit and export videos online, no installation required.

- Enables AI-powered video editing and 1080p MP4 export from Mac screen recordings.
- Simple setup: automatic backend connection with free token (100 credits, 7-day validity).
- Drag-and-drop uploads; describe desired edits in plain language.
- Common actions supported: trimming, adding transitions, overlaying text, audio, and quick exporting.
- Cloud GPU backend processes typical videos in 1–2 minutes; supports batch and iterative workflows.
- Clear feedback for session status, credits, file limits, and error messages.
